zh.title: 目标已经换了，旧证据还能记功吗？
zh.summary: 固定版本的内存实验显示轮次与对象身份如何拒绝过期证明；记功通过仍不能替代远端观察、部署归属和正常业务验证。

en.title: Can Old Evidence Earn Credit After the Objective Changes?
en.summary: Pinned in-memory experiments show how rounds and object identity reject stale proof; accepted credit still cannot establish remote observation, deployed revision or ordinary-workflow preservation.
